name: East Coast Sour Diesel 1g Live Resin Disposable
description: Lineage: Original Diesel x DNL Type: Sativa Terpenes: Myrcene, Caryophyllene, Limonene Effects: Energetic, Uplifted, Focused Aroma: Diesel, Citrusy, Earthy Welcome to the high-energy rush of East Coast Sour Diesel, a sativa that delivers a punch of vibrant energy and focus. With its lime-green buds dusted in frosty trichomes, this strain is as visually captivating as it is invigorating. The bold aroma of diesel fuel collides with bright, citrusy notes, creating a zesty, fresh scent that hints at adventure. As the effects kick in, feel the clarity take over, your mind sharpening and your body coming alive with motivation. Whether you're diving into a creative project or simply seizing the day, East Coast Sour Diesel keeps you uplifted, alert, and ready to tackle whatever comes next. It’s the perfect fuel for a day full of action and inspiration.
